problem: _in_window now evicts at fixed bucket boundaries ((now // window) * window) instead of now - window, turning SlidingWindowLimiter into a fixed-window limiter that admits up to 2x limit across a boundary (limit=2, window=10: allow at 9, 9.5, 10, 10.5 all return True vs [T,T,F,F] on main), and the comment documenting the (now - window, now] contract was deleted.

retry_after still returns the sliding-window value q[0] + window - now while eviction now happens at bucket boundaries, so it contradicts allow (limit=1, window=10: after allow at 9, retry_after(9.5) returns 9.5 but allow(10) succeeds).
The core eviction rule changed with no tests in the repository, so nothing catches the boundary burst, the expiry edge, or retry_after disagreeing with allow.
